description.text: Grants [Attach Water with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Paine], [Full Throttle Cap Break Damage Tracker] and [Full Throttle Cap Break Level]

description.name: Attach Water with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Paine
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Full Throttle Cap Break (0~2), removed after using Full Throttle Cap Break two times

description.name: Full Throttle Cap Break Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Full Throttle Cap Break level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Paine]

description.name: Full Throttle Cap Break Level
description.text: Keeps track of Full Throttle Cap Break level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Paine]
